name: Highlife dance-band 4/4 kit
desc: The straight dance-band / burger-highlife cousin: son-clave-ish TR707 cowbell rotating every phrase, a 0-3-6 afro kick, backbeat snare and skippy offbeat open-hats — brighter and squarer than the 12/8 bell, with a filter breath and 4-bar hat fill.

code.full: stack(s('cb(5,8,<0 2 4 6>)').gain(${bell}).lpf(${cut}).room(.12), s('bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~').bank('RolandTR707').gain(${gain}).shape(${drive}), s('~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ sd ~').bank('RolandTR707').gain(${snare}), s('hh*8').bank('RolandTR707').gain('[0.7 0.45]*4').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5,${cut}).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2))).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s('cb(5,8,<0 2 4 6>)').gain(${bell}).lpf(${cut}).room(.12), s('<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~]>').bank('RolandTR707').gain(${gain}).shape(${drive}), s('~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ sd ~').bank('RolandTR707').gain(${snare}), s('hh*8').bank('RolandTR707').gain('[0.8 0.5]*4').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}).slow(12)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)), s('~ oh ~ oh ~ oh ~ oh').bank('RolandTR707').gain(${snare}).lpf(${cut})).orbit(1).play()
